name: Hospitality Services Companion
subtitle: Independent Bahrain guide
promotionalText: Prepare Bahrain hospitality service requirements, drafts, and inspection checklists on your device.
description:
Hospitality Services Companion is an independent, source-attributed preparation tool for Bahrain hospitality and tourism services.

Browse 19 publicly listed service areas, review published requirements, save favorites, prepare local application drafts, track document readiness, complete inspection checklists, and keep complaint working copies on your device.

The companion does not authenticate users, process payments, make regulatory decisions, or submit information to protected government systems. When an official action is required, the app links directly to its named source.

This app is not operated by, affiliated with, or endorsed by BTEA or the Government of Bahrain. Official information sources are linked throughout the app and include https://portal.btea.bh/.
